Body.Content:
Azure Batch AI Service is now available. Azure Batch AI Service helps you train and test deep learning and other machine learning models using GPU and CPU clusters. There's no additional charge for using Batch AI Preview beyond the underlying compute and other resources consumed. Batch AI Preview supports both standard and low priority virtual machines. Only Linux virtual machines in the East US region are supported in the preview.

 

For more information, visit Azure Batch AI Preview.
